hints.title: Do you need every value?
hints.body: You only care about the largest `k` values. What is the smallest amount of information you can keep while scanning the list once?

hints.title: Keep the best k
hints.body: A min-heap of size `k` keeps the `k` largest values seen so far. The smallest value in that heap is the current `k`-th largest.

hints.title: Push, then trim
hints.body: For each value, push it into the min-heap. If the heap grows beyond `k`, pop the smallest value. After the scan, the heap contains exactly the `k` largest values, and its root is the answer.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
heap = empty min-heap
for value in nums:
    push value onto heap
    if size(heap) > k:
        pop the smallest value from heap
return the smallest value in heap
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Translate it into your language and check it against the examples.
